figure: Figure 1(e), x polarization; Figure 1(f), y polarization
method: Component-wise median of a 17 × 17 pixel window centered inside each published color-map cell; 8-bit RGB hex. Coordinates are zero-based.
scope: Samples from the published rendered image, not original numerical spectra or experimental measurements. The animation uses the middle y-pol sample for all five designs to summarize near invariance; the source has small variations. Intermediate polarization colors are visual interpolation, not a simulated angle sweep. Layer thicknesses and cutaway transparency are schematic. The source image is not redistributed.
